world.fictional_geography_notice: OSM-derived Kappil road/coast with an artistic Kochi-inspired infrastructure remix. Metro, transit route, buildings, promenade and flyover are fictional, not a geographic/survey claim. Marine Drive itself is pedestrian-only; this race road runs alongside an inspired promenade, not on it.

districts.name: Coastal Villages
districts.description: Coconut coastline, fishing houses and small roadside shops.

districts.name: Metro Market
districts.description: Dense commercial blocks, mid-rise homes and elevated metro station.

districts.name: Skyline Flyover
districts.description: Smooth raised racing roadway above a narrow coastal neighborhood.

districts.name: Backwater Quarter
districts.description: Water-transit terminal, waterfront promenade, fishing nets and varied urban blocks.

districts.name: Harbour Avenue
districts.description: Palm-lined shop streets and mid-rise residential blocks.

transit_routes.description: Fictional Kochi-inspired elevated three-car metro, not an actual Kappil service.
Fictional low-wake water-transit shuttle, not an official route or navigational chart.

world.landscape_policy: Building footprints and metro pier foundations tested against original OSM land minus water. Docks, submerged ferry hull and fishing-net booms intentionally extend over water.
